title: Mass gap: integer multiplicity 0-currents of mass < 1 vanish
statement: Assume (MR), the exact frozen statement of cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure, which appears verbatim as the hypothesis of the Lean statement: for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every integer multiplicity representation R : IMRep U n of T (R.Represents T), T.massOn W = R.measure W for every open W, where R.measure = (μHE[n] restricted to R.carrier) with density R.mult. Then for every P ∈ ℕ, every integer multiplicity current Z ∈ 𝒟_0(ℝ^P) with M(Z) = Z.mass < 1 is the zero current.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 0), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → Z.mass < 1 → Z = 0
